description: NaErCl₄ is beta Vanadium nitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent ErCl₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-53°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.74-2.88 Å. Er³⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form ErCl₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent ErCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-53°. There are a spread of Er-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.72 Å. There are two inequivalent Cl¹⁻ sites. In the first Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Er³⁺ atom. In the second Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Er³⁺ atoms.
